sheets.request:
Sheet gate16.png: the MAIN ENTRANCE GATE of a cozy zoo, 4 upgrade tiers. It must clearly read as a real zoo entrance at a glance.
View: FRONT-FACING, gentle 3/4 top-down (we see the front face of the gate and a little of its top). The gate stands across the visitors' path: two thick pillars left and right, a big arch beam across the top, and a wide OPEN passage in the middle with gate doors swung open inward. A big signboard sits on top of the arch: leave the board BLANK (no letters), decorate its edges with cute animal shapes (ears on top, paw prints). A small ticket window is built into the left pillar. Small soft shadow at the base.
Layout: 2 columns x 2 rows, one gate per cell, each about 96 art pixels wide and 88 tall, bottom-aligned, lots of magenta around.
1 (top-left) tier 1: rustic wooden ranch gate, log pillars, wooden arch with rope and two hanging lanterns, signboard of planks with carved bear ears on top, potted ferns at the base.
2 (top-right) tier 2: stone gate, rounded fieldstone pillars with ivy, stone arch, carved stone plaque with lion ears, two lamp posts on the pillars.
3 (bottom-left) tier 3: red brick pillars with white stone caps, dark green ornate iron arch with scrollwork, big round blank emblem in the middle, two small flags on top.
4 (bottom-right) tier 4: grand gate of white marble with golden roof tiles and golden trims, a small lion statue on the left pillar and an elephant statue on the right pillar, colorful banners, warm lights.
The four tiers share the same size, proportions and opening width so they can replace each other.
Image size 1536x1536, solid #FF00FF background, no text.
rows: tier 3 brick and green iron zoo entrance
tier 4 marble and gold zoo entrance
